prompt: We need to make miadi-code's MCP PDE server store decompositions in Redis and serve them through the web UI at app/api/pde and app/pde. The storage format should align with miaco's .pde/ folder convention but I am not sure if Redis replaces the filesystem or supplements it.

primary.target: miadi-code MCP PDE server Redis-backed storage and web endpoints (app/api/pde, app/pde)

secondary.target: miaco .pde/ folder convention/spec to ensure storage format alignment
Redis schema/keys to represent PDE decompositions matching .pde/ layout
whether Redis replaces filesystem or supplements it (single source-of-truth policy)
backend storage module (Redis client, save/load/delete operations)
MCP PDE server to persist and retrieve decompositions via the new storage module
HTTP API at app/api/pde to expose CRUD and listing operations
secondary.dependency: update MCP PDE server storage integration

secondary.target: web UI at app/pde to read/write via new API endpoints and render decompositions
existing .pde files (if any) into Redis or create sync layer
unit, integration and E2E flows: save/load/list via API and UI
storage design, replacement-vs-supplement decision, migration steps and API

files_needed: mcp/pde server code (server entry and PDE handlers)
.pde/ spec or example folder from miaco (to mirror format)
tools_required: Redis client library (matching server language, e.g., redis-py or node-redis)
test runner used by project (pytest, jest, etc.)
assumptions: miadi-code MCP PDE server source is available and modifiable
app/api/pde and app/pde correspond to real backend and frontend entrypoints
miaco .pde/ convention is the canonical storage shape to mirror
Redis is acceptable as a storage backend (performance/persistence needs met)
There may be existing .pde files to migrate, but location/volume is unknown

updates: mcp/pde server config (add Redis connection config)
README or docs describing storage behavior

Issue/Discussion: Confirm replace vs supplement policy for Redis vs filesystem
Docs: Migration guide and API docs for app/api/pde

ambiguities.text: Unclear whether Redis should replace the filesystem or supplement it
ambiguities.suggestion: Decide policy: (A) Redis as authoritative store (migrate files and update all reads/writes), or (B) Redis as cache/index with filesystem as source-of-truth. Provide pros/cons and pick one.

ambiguities.text: Unspecified persistence/backup strategy for Redis (AOF/RDB, backups)
ambiguities.suggestion: Specify persistence requirements and backup frequency; if unsure, default to enabling AOF and regular snapshot backups.

ambiguities.text: Unknown which fields/attachments in .pde/ must be preserved (versions, binary attachments)
ambiguities.suggestion: List required .pde/ artifacts to preserve (metadata, text files, attachments, timestamps). If attachments exist, choose either Redis (not ideal for large blobs) or leave blobs on filesystem/object store and store references in Redis.

ambiguities.text: Project language/framework not specified for exact integration steps
ambiguities.suggestion: Detect server language from repo; if multiple options, implement storage module in the server's native language (e.g., Python/Node).
